name: Current: Durum wheat - Sunflower
why: This is what the field grows today. It is the baseline the other options are compared against.

evidence.fact: NASA POWER 2001-2025: rain in the growing months covers 66% (Durum wheat), 22% (Sunflower) of the crop water need (Kc x ET0).
NASA POWER 2001-2025: average weekly chance of the main hazard in the sensitive weeks: Durum wheat heat 0% (Apr-May), Sunflower heat 48% (Jun-Jul).

NASA POWER 2001-2025: 41% of the year's heavy-rain frequency (days of 20 mm or more) falls while this rotation leaves the soil bare (bare in some or all years: Jan, Feb, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec).

risks: Soil left bare from July to October

name: A: Durum wheat - Chickpea
why: A legume replaces sunflower: it adds nitrogen to the soil and uses less water in summer.

evidence.fact: NASA POWER 2001-2025: rain in the growing months covers 66% (Durum wheat), 54% (Chickpea) of the crop water need (Kc x ET0).
NASA POWER 2001-2025: average weekly chance of the main hazard in the sensitive weeks: Durum wheat heat 0% (Apr-May), Chickpea heat 0% (Apr-May).
NASA POWER 2001-2025: 36% of the year's heavy-rain frequency (days of 20 mm or more) falls while this rotation leaves the soil bare (bare in some or all years: Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec).

benefits: Less nitrogen fertiliser for the next wheat
risks: Chickpea is sensitive to heat at flowering

name: B: Barley - Vetch - Durum wheat
why: A three-year cycle with a vetch year that covers the soil and rebuilds organic matter.

evidence.fact: NASA POWER 2001-2025: rain in the growing months covers 72% (Barley), 66% (Durum wheat) of the crop water need (Kc x ET0). Not scored for water: Vetch (forage / green manure) (no FAO-56 Kc).
NASA POWER 2001-2025: average weekly chance of the main hazard in the sensitive weeks: Barley heat 0% (Apr), Vetch (forage / green manure) frost 14% (Feb-Mar), Durum wheat heat 0% (Apr-May).
NASA POWER 2001-2025: 13% of the year's heavy-rain frequency (days of 20 mm or more) falls while this rotation leaves the soil bare (bare in some or all years: May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct).

benefits: Barley avoids the worst summer heat
gaps: Forage demand and price not checked
risks: Needs a buyer or use for the forage

name: C: Wheat - Sunflower - Chickpea + cover crop
why: Keeps the familiar crops but adds a legume and a winter cover crop.

evidence.fact: NASA POWER 2001-2025: rain in the growing months covers 66% (Durum wheat), 22% (Sunflower), 54% (Chickpea) of the crop water need (Kc x ET0). Not scored for water: Winter cover crop (no FAO-56 Kc).

NASA POWER 2001-2025: average weekly chance of the main hazard in the sensitive weeks: Durum wheat heat 0% (Apr-May), Sunflower heat 48% (Jun-Jul), Chickpea heat 0% (Apr-May), Winter cover crop frost 4% (Nov-Dec).

NASA POWER 2001-2025: 43% of the year's heavy-rain frequency (days of 20 mm or more) falls while this rotation leaves the soil bare (bare in some or all years: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec).

benefits: Familiar crops stay in the plan
gaps: Cover crop seed cost not included
Few local trials in rainfed soils
risks: Cover crop may fail in a dry autumn
